blocks.prompt: Which debugging habit fits prefix sums best?
choices: Trace one small state change before trying a larger input
Start with the largest hidden case
Change the data structure after each failed test
Ignore the saved state and read only the final answer
blocks.why: One three-item list is enough to reveal whether the formula includes the right endpoint and excludes the value before left.

sections.summary: Prefix code often mixes conventions. If prefix[i] sometimes means through i and sometimes before i, range answers drift.
